description: This file defines the interface for CCSP message bus APIs used to access the Data Model, including functions for creating/destroying bus objects, getting/setting parameters, managing object instances, and related data structures and enums.

methods.name: MBus_Create
methods.description: Creates a CCSP message bus object for accessing TR-181 data model, with parameters for subsystem, config file, component ID, and component CR ID.

methods.name: MBus_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys a previously created message bus object.

methods.name: MBus_GetParamVal
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified parameter from the data model.

methods.name: MBus_SetParamVal
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified parameter in the data model.

methods.name: MBus_Commit
methods.description: Commits the parameter changes made before.

methods.name: MBus_FindObjectIns
methods.description: Finds object instances based on a prefix path, optionally matching parameter name and value.

methods.name: MBus_AddObjectIns
methods.description: Adds a new instance of an object.

methods.name: FindFirstInstance
methods.description: Finds the first instance of an object.

methods.name: GetParamValueForIns
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a parameter for a specific object instance.
